stories.title: Microsoft Outlook to block MSIX attachments starting November
stories.summary: Microsoft announced that it will add .msix and .msixbundle attachments to the list of blocked attachments in Outlook Web and the new Outlook Windows client starting next month.

stories.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
stories.summary: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

stories.title: France summons Iranian ambassador over 'disinformation campaign' on school protests
stories.summary: France said the Iranian authorities' comments on high school protests currently rocking France were 'absolutely unacceptable,' after Iran, which repressed a protest movement in January, accused France of 'human rights violations.'

stories.title: French luxury giant Louis Vuitton to fund two Paris streets' redevelopment
stories.summary: The French luxury brand, part of the LVMH conglomerate, will fund up to €2 million in renovations to two streets around its future flagship store, a move Mayor Emmanuel Grégoire said he 'fully stood by' despite opposition to it.

stories.title: 'Draining' few days for Gauff after online racist abuse
stories.summary: Coco Gauff says she had a "draining" few days after receiving racist abuse online before her fourth-round China Open exit.

kev.name: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
kev.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

kev.name: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
kev.summary: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.

entries.title: Someone is counter-programming launch day
entries.body: Devolver Digital has a mystery game dated 19 November. Pre-orders have been open since June: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99, no special edition.
